name: hh-arc
notes: Hopping Heads Arc game server. Env (PORT, DATABASE_URL, SESSION_SECRET, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, CHAIN_ID) lives in Pier, never in the repo. See .env.example. The escrow keys (OWNER_KEY, OPERATOR_KEY, SIGNER_KEY, PLAYER_KEY, ESCROW_ADDRESS) belong in Pier too once the settlement service exists (phase 4); phase 3 drives the contract from contracts/cli only. The contracts gate step skips with a notice when arc-forge is not on PATH.
